narrative.overview: Scoped record of the implemented fictional Dapur Saji catering example. The confirmed direction is warm editorial food imagery, large type and generous space, with ivory, deep olive and terracotta. Source authority is the component, scoped CSS, curation contract and four inspected desktop/mobile screenshots. No new creative metaphor or global WUUS identity is asserted.
keyCharacteristics: Outfit headings and Satoshi body with Georgia italic hero accent
Open catalogue items and alternating flat section surfaces
Local menu selection and copyable order planning

rules.name: Scoped authority
rules.body: Apply only within Dapur Saji; this artifact does not redefine global WUUS design.

rules.name: Observed depth
rules.body: Only the hero photo note and fixed mobile cart have shadows in the current implementation.

dos: Do retain the public Contoh desain label and AI-image disclosure.
Do preserve the focus outline, reduced-motion behavior and responsive stacking.
Do distinguish illustrative prices and a local summary from a submitted order.
donts: Don't infer global WUUS identity from this concept.
Don't claim customers, sales, payments, deliveries or a real catering affiliation.
Don't treat screenshot selections as default state or invent unobserved tonal ramps.
